The center cap is yellow with black text reading 'SUNRAYS' and '15x6J'. Five lug nuts are visible in the bolt holes. A portion of the black rubber tire is visible at the top edge. The background shows dark recesses of the wheel well.

To rigorously evaluate the legibility and structural integrity of the text on the yellow hub cap, which showed signs of gibberish.
